android.desc:
Mind mapping helps you organize your thoughts, remember information and generate new ideas. We've created a beautiful, intuitive app, so you can mind map wherever you are and whenever you want.

SimpleMind Pro for Android is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

Highlights
• Easy to use.
• Add images and documents.
• Share Mind Maps.
• Customize the style of the Mind Map.
• Continuously fine-tuned based on customer feedback.
• Tools to help you maintain overview.

Private by Design
• No ads.
• No tracking.
• No need to sign up for an account.
• We do not have access to your Mind Maps.

Create
• Place topics anywhere you want in the free-form layout.
• Use various auto layouts.
• Reorganize and restructure topics.
• Connect any two topics with a crosslink.
• Label relations.

Tools to help you maintain overview
• Collapse and expand branches.
• Block out distractions with autofocus.
• Visually group topics with group borders.
• Outline view.
• Search and filter.

Enrich your Mind Map
• Images and photos.
• Notes.
• Icons.
• Link to a mind map, contact, file or webpage.
• Checkboxes.

Style your mind map
• Change the overall appearance by selecting one of the many style sheets.
• Create your own style sheets.
• Style every detail, exactly how you want it.

Share Mind Maps
• PDF, Image and more.
• Outline text.
• Create a slideshow to present your Mind Map (tablet only).
• Print.
• Exchange as OPML, for example with AI apps.

Safely store and sync your Mind Maps
• You control where your Mind Maps are stored.
• Sync Mind Maps across devices using Dropbox or other clouds.
• SimpleMind is designed to open your Mind Maps across platforms.
• SimpleMind for Mac, Windows and iPad&iPhone are sold separately.

SimpleMind for Android is optimized for phones and tablets.

quotes.text:
Well you have this at roughly $2000 total: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.sarasarasa.lifeup

And this at almost a million dollars: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.modelmakertools.simplemindpro

I'm not sure if these are outliers, and my "random" sampling is just picking out highly visible apps. But I've made good money off an app built in a month, and I've made relatively little from a book written in 3 months.

Software has a lot more variety. You can make say, a communist themed productivity app vs a forest themed one and these will appeal to different people.
quotes.story_title: Writing books is not really a good idea
